persona.summary: Founder-led 25-staff shop, 2-5 M EUR; our ~EUR 219k is ~4-11 % of its turnover. Won a large hydraulics contract and confirms extra volume only against binding 12-month commitments. Holds 70 % of pump shaft HN 24 mm at 24.92, already 1.2 % below its own plant should-cost; sup:70210 holds 30 % at 24.37 with free capacity. Open moderately, buy price with lead time and binding volume, use sup:70210 and the amber scorecard, do not squeeze hard.
persona.notes: Needs binding volume and planning security; fears tying capacity to unplanned demand. Price below its full cost yet it gave 2.7-2.9 % reductions in 2023 and 2025. We pay 9.8 days late on average (79 % >5 days late) without written complaint. OTD 69-81 %, 1 open 8D.

arguments: rival price: sup:70210 at 24.37 on the same part
contract §3.1: no increase notice by 2 Oct
avoid: deep opening (capacity-tight bots jump to a final offer)
squeezing far below 24.37 (already below its cost)
changing terms after a final offer
mandatory_terms: binding commitment for any additional volume
tactics: Open moderately, aiming at sup:70210's 24.37 rather than a deep cut.
Offer a binding 12-month volume and accept its 35-day or longer lead time for price.
Mention sup:70210 has free capacity for more of the 24 mm shaft.
Use the scorecard once; do not cite drivers that rose.
playbook.expected_concession: Small: renewals settled 1.7-3.7 pts below its ask, but price is already below its cost; expect 1-2 % at most.
